noData.pending: This profile doesn't contain any data yet! The viewer will refresh shortly.
noData.empty: This profile doesn't contain any data!

socket.description:
spark viewer is connected to the spark profiler using a socket connection.
The statistics will update every {{interval}} seconds, and the profiler data will update every minute.

all.title: Profiler - All View
all.desc: This is the default profiler view. It shows the entire profile as an expandable tree.

flat.title: Profiler - Flat View
flat.desc: This view shows a flattened representation of the profile, where the top 250 method calls are listed.

sources.title: Profiler - {{noun}} View
sources.desc: This view shows a filtered representation of the profile broken down by {{noun}}.

sources.otherDesc: The following other {{noun}} are installed, but didn't show up in this profile. Yay!

display.title: Display
display.bottomUpDesc: The call tree is reversed - expanding a node reveals the method that called it.
display.topDownDesc: The call tree is 'normal' - expanding a node reveals the sub-methods that it calls.

labelMode.title: Label
labelMode.bytesPerSecondDesc: The value displayed is the number of bytes of memory allocated per second on average (memory pressure) by each frame.
labelMode.percentageBytesDesc: The value displayed is number of bytes of memory allocated by each frame divided by the total allocated as a percentage.
labelMode.timePerTickDesc: The value displayed against each frame is the average time in milliseconds spent executing the method each tick.
labelMode.percentageTimeDesc: The value displayed against each frame is the time divided by the total time as a percentage.

mergeMode.title: Merge Mode
mergeMode.mergeDesc: Method calls with the same signature will be merged together, even though they may not have been invoked by the same calling method.
mergeMode.separateDesc: Method calls that have the same signature, but that haven't been invoked by the same calling method will show separately.

sortMode.title: Sort Mode
sortMode.selfBytesDesc: Methods are sorted according to the number of bytes of memory allocated directly within the method
sortMode.totalBytesDesc: Methods are sorted according to the number of bytes of memory allocated directly within the method as well as allocations in sub-calls
sortMode.selfTimeDesc: Methods are sorted according to their 'self time' (the time spent executing code within the method)
sortMode.totalTimeDesc: Methods are sorted according to their 'total time' (the time spent executing code within the method and the time spent executing sub-calls)

refine.title: Refine
refine.description: The graph below shows some key metrics over the course of the profile. You can drag + select with your cursor to refine the profile to a specific time period.
